backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (email updates, Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Export Certification pages) to their affected files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and key implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining light and dark mode CSS custom properties for the shadcn-ui design token system using OKLCH color values.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React app with the page title set to 'True Origin Company LLP' and a root div that mounts the Vite/React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application file that sets up TanStack Router with routes for home, privacy policy, terms, and export certification pages, and includes a responsive NavBar with smooth-scroll navigation and language selection.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component rendering company stats, descriptive paragraphs, and three value cards (natural, quality, logistics) with all text sourced from the centralized translations system.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with an info panel showing address, phone, and two clickable mailto email links (info@ and sales@trueoriginexports.com), plus an enquiry form with submission state handling.
frontend/src/components/ExportCargoSecti: Renders the 'Exports' section of the homepage with a header, two cargo images, and a four-item highlights grid using icons and i18n translation keys.
frontend/src/components/ExportCertificat: Full-page component displaying export certifications, quality control steps, and product specification tables for four products (moringa powder, moringa leaf, curry leaves, okra) with i18n support.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand logo, contact details, quick navigation links that support smooth-scrolling from any route, and legal/social links, all translated via i18n.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a farm background image, gradient overlay, company name, tagline, and CTA buttons that smooth-scroll to other sections.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown component for switching between English, Hindi, and Marathi using the LanguageContext, with styling that adapts based on whether the navbar is scrolled.
frontend/src/components/PrivacyPolicyPag: Standalone privacy policy page that renders translated sections, an intro block, and a contact callout, scrolling to the top on mount.
Renders a products section displaying five moringa-based product cards with translated names, descriptions, category badges, and tags, plus a grid of farm images.
frontend/src/components/SocialMediaSecti: Renders a social media section with placeholder icons for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Facebook (all marked 'coming soon') and three video placeholder cards with translated titles and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/TermsAndConditio: Displays the Terms and Conditions page with eight translated sections, an intro block, and a contact callout, scrolling to the top on mount.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a React context for language selection (en/hi/mr) and a translation lookup function `t` that falls back to English or the raw key.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` and `useInternetIdentity` hook that manage DFINITY AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout, and identity state with status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global CSS including Google Fonts imports, Tailwind directives, and a custom earthy green/cream design token palette for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/translations/translations.t: Defines the TypeScript union type `TranslationKeys` enumerating all i18n string keys used across the site, covering navigation, hero, about, products, export, social, contact, footer, privacy policy, and terms sections.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), an extended color palette using OKLCH CSS variables (including brand tokens like forest, moss, sage, gold), custom border radii, box shadows, and registers the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 15) for the True Origin Company LLP marketing website, recording the architectural summary, known issues, existing features, and notes on planned additions such as multi-language support, new static pages (Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Export Certification), and updated contact details.
